title: Decalage and the original step have the same cohomology image
statement: Let K be any cochain complex in an abelian category, with decreasing filtration L. For every pair of integers a,n, the image in H^n(K) of the shifted-cycle inclusion Dec(L)^a into K [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage] equals the image of the inclusion L^(a+n) into K. No boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homology

proof.text: For a monomorphism of complexes V into K, identify the image of Z^n(V) in K^n with the intersection of the degree-n image and ker(d). Construct the reverse factorization using liftCycles. For Dec(L), intersection with ker(d) makes its inverse-image condition automatic. Cancel the monic Z^n(K) inclusion to get equal cycle images, and push them along the cycle-to-homology epimorphism. Naturality identifies the results with the two homology images.

lean.statement:
theorem decalage_image (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (L : DecreasingFiltration K) (a n : ℤ) :
    imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (L.decalageι a) n) =
      imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (L.step (a + n)).arrow n)
